text: "A productive day starts with hard work! Come on, you can do it!" Against the backdrop of a subway inspirational ad, another day as a café employee begins.

Luckily, working in a café isn't all rushing about all the time. Outside peak times, it could even be described as leisurely. Now's the time we usually receive most of our delivery orders and, as it happens, I catch sight of a familiar address: Lotus Gardens.
As expected, another almost imperceptible frown crossed A-37's face when he saw the address.

Well, I kind of know the delivery ropes now, and it's the same customer at the same address. I walk to A-37 and wave my hand in front of his face. After getting his attention, I pick up the delivery box with ease.
Clearly not expecting me to suddenly call myself his employer, A-37 is stunned for a moment. Luckily, he quickly realizes I'm joking, to relieve some of the pressure.
Unless my ears deceive me, that was the sound of A-37 making a joke... Nice progress, A-37!
Standing in front of the familiar door, I can't help but sigh with emotion. Yesterday I never would have guessed that my second meeting with Saturne would come so soon.
Saturne's just as quick as last time, opening the door before the chime of the bells has faded.
Taking the bag in my hands, Saturne opens it and looks inside. Two bottles of sparkling orange lie coolly within.
I can't really say that this invitation is totally unexpected, and it would be rude to decline, as I'd promised Saturne yesterday. So I nodded, and followed him through to the garden.

What strikes me is the brightly colored tablecloth that now adorns the table, on which is piled even more of my favorite snacks. The flower bouquets have also changed from yesterday's lilies into today's pink roses.
Dewdrops roll down the delicately-scented petals, reflecting the soft light and gladdening the heart of all who see it. I have to admit, Saturne is a meticulous and considerate person.
Even though the main reason I'm here is that A-37 refused to deliver here, Saturne's not wrong. I really did enjoy my conversation with him and didn't mind coming back.

Strictly speaking, I don't really know that much about the Four Great Jyanshis. I haven't met any of them except for Kazuha Saionji, and it's not like I know a lot about her other than that she is the master of the Nishiha Dojo. She has never once told me about how she became one of the Four Greats.
All I know is hearsay: that there was a grand, intense tournament, where the final round was even closed to the public... Choosing my words carefully, I tell Saturne what little I know.
The image of Miki Nikaidou floats into my mind. All the legends of the Four Greats I'd heard were from her, and she'd actually been there at the last tournament.
I consider Saturne's words and agree that, alongside extolling the exquisite beauty of gemstones, people often discussed what good luck each of them symbolized.

As he says this, he shakes the sparkling orange in his hand, agitating the tiny bubbles to seethe more vigorously. Saturne squints at the churning bubbles with a smile, before suddenly lowering his voice and addressing me.
Although Saturne has thrown in a lot of business jargon, I understand the last sentence—gossip is human nature!
Saturne raises his sparkling orange to me with a slight smile, then takes a small sip.
I recall what Saturne told me before, about how there was no sparkling orange where he came from. Even though it is a boringly common drink for me, I think I understand his feeling.
Saturne smiles at me, before continuing in a low voice.

Saturne's question piques my curiosity, but the only person I can think of who can help is Miki, as she played in tournaments before... Actually, maybe the two people in charge of the Mahjong Soul Shrine know something too, if they'd be willing to tell me.

Saturne raises his sparkling orange to me with a slight smile, then takes a small sip. It feels like we have suddenly formed some kind of tacit alliance. Should we call ourselves the Curiosity Alliance? Or perhaps, more simply, the Gossipers?

I raise my sparkling orange to Saturne too, toasting him in mid-air. While he's still clearly some business titan, knowing he has this side to him makes Saturne much more approachable. It's as A-37 said: The more you get to know someone, the easier you'll see their other side.
For some reason, A-37's refusal to make the delivery actually makes him seem more approachable.

For as long as I can remember, he always seems like he can do anything. But now, knowing that he, too, has his own troubles and things that he doesn't like to do, I suddenly see him as just a normal person like us. But I think I should still go check up on him.
He looks at me, shaking his head.
A-37 point-blank interrupts me, before resuming his usual, thousand-miles-distant manner. After checking that everything is correct with the delivery, I go to help Reina sort out the payment.
Hearing a familiar voice, I look up and see Eve. She is still by herself, and as I lead her to a table, I notice that she has heavier dark circles under her eyes than yesterday.
Eve shakes her head, then immediately flashes me a firm smile.
Eve's eyes lit up when Lily is mentioned, and she seems totally re-energized. They clearly have a good relationship.
Eve opens the photo app on her phone, found one particular picture and holds it up for me to look at.
The picture looks a few years old, as it shows Eve with long hair. Sitting next to her was a blonde nun, youthful and almost radiating a soft, pure aura.

Eve thanks me profusely while sending me copies of her photos through Bluetooth. The girl on the phone is laughing so happily, I hope I can help her find Lily soon, so that this brilliant, beautiful smile can appear once again.

Perhaps it's because I promised to help her, Eve seems noticeably relaxed and says that she wants to do the coffee challenge. Having learned my lesson, I decided to bring her a black tea latte, as the name implies, the main ingredients are black tea and milk.

I've always wondered why most cafés include totally decaffeinated drinks in the coffee list, but it certainly has given me some inspiration. Eve, who doesn't remember much of her caffeine high yesterday, only really knows that coffee was a challenging drink for her.
I subtly hide the Éternité menu which clearly states "Lattes (main ingredient: milk)", intending to tell Eve a harmless little white lie... Well, I don't suppose it even counts as a lie, in a sense.

Eve seems really pleased, and proud that she has successfully increased her caffeine tolerance. This time, she had a whole cup of "coffee", without any adverse reactions! I should let her try matcha latte next time she's here!
Eve's eyes widen in disbelief.
When I find Reina, she's folding uniforms in the staff room.
Seeing the two in such high spirits, I quietly leave the staff room.
Eve's expression darkens somewhat, and she shakes her head.
When I get back from Saturne's place, Ichihime seems to look at me with a twinkle in her eye.
Hold on, since when has it evolved into this? No... Maybe it's better to ask why making a delivery to Saturne has been described as such a dangerous undertaking?
No, you don't have a clue...

I go home after such a busy day, and the promise I made to Saturne comes to my mind. Maybe I should just go and ask Miki for him after work tomorrow. I haven't seen Miki for ages anyway. I wonder how she's doing lately.

I go home after such a busy day, and the promise I made to Eve comes to my mind. Suddenly, an idea comes to me! Isn't Ichihime the best person I know to help find someone? As the priestess of Mahjong Soul Shrine, she must see so many people every day. I'll ask her when I get to the café tomorrow!
Make the delivery for A-37
Stay and help out around the café
Curious why Saturne's interested in the Four Great Jyanshis
Tell Saturne what I know
{character:player}A productive day starts with hard work, and hard work starts with a good mindset! Just let me handle this delivery today, too.
{character:A-37} It's okay. Anyway, I can...
{character:player} Hmm... Well, if that's the way it has to be... Ahem, consider it an order from your employer.
{character:A-37} Looks like I may have underestimated you. Indeed, you're more than capable to handle a simple delivery. I'll leave it to you then.
{character:Saturne} As I expected, you'd be the one making the delivery today too.
{character:player} Yes, Mr. Saturne. I've got your delivery right here.
{character:player} I noticed that you ordered two bottles of sparkling orange again. Is your friend who canceled yesterday coming today?
{character:Saturne} Well, I do hope to have a guest, but not that gentleman. I don't know if you have time today, but I'd like to treat you to afternoon tea.
{character:Saturne} It was lovely meeting you yesterday, but I fear I was unable to entertain you properly in such a rush. I do hope you'd be able to enjoy yourself more today.
{character:player} So... You prepared such a lavish spread just for me? What if someone else came to deliver?
{character:Saturne} Haha, well now! I thought that because we had such a lovely conversation yesterday, you'd be willing to come again. And I was correct, was I not?
{character:player} I suppose so, but you should know that I'm only working at Éternité temporarily. In a few days this job will be over, and you won't see me in this capacity again.

{character:Saturne} Alas, sorry to hear that! I was very much looking forward to conversing further, as I feel the blood of the city running through your veins and would love to learn more about this place.

{character:player} Huh? If that's the case... I guess I've been in One Han City a while now and experienced a lot. Though I can't say I know everything there is to know, I do think I've got a good grasp of the place.
{character:Saturne} So... I take it that it's alright to ask you a few questions about this fair city?
{character:player} Of course.
{character:Saturne} Let me see... Recently, I've been hearing something about the Four Great Jyanshis of One Han City. Do you know anything about them?

{character:player} Probably everyone in One Han City has heard the legend of the Four Great Jyanshis, but most people only know that they acquired their status through a tournament of Mahjong Soul Shrine.
{character:Saturne} Ha! Sure enough, everyone seems to have the same level of knowledge about them. It makes me wonder if that tournament even exists.
{character:player} Uh, there may be someone... who knows a bit more...
{character:Saturne} Oh? Then would you mind asking this knowledgeable insider for me?
Player
Saturne
{character:player} Sure.... But, may I ask you something?
{character:Saturne} No need for such formality! Feel free to ask any questions you have.
{character:player} I'm just curious why you want to know about the Four Greats.
{character:Saturne} Haha! My apologies, I just remembered I haven't told you what I do. I am a gemstone dealer.
{character:player} Gemstones...? I'm sorry, I can't quite see how that relates to the Four Greats?

{character:Saturne} Perhaps this is a particular habit of mine, haha! As I'm sure you know, different customs and habits abound in this world of ours. I have found in my business travels that the further east people live, the more they like to use various things to represent good wishes, and gemstones are an example of such.

{character:Saturne} As an example, in One Han City people often believe that amethysts protect knowledge, diamonds represent enduring love, and rubies are conducive to health and longevity... So it behooves someone in my profession to understand the local customs and legends wherever they go. Call it market research, if you will.
{character:player} So you want to use the legend of the Four Greats to... Sell gemstones?
{character:Saturne} Well, yes, but that's only part of it. Collaboration with people that can represent a particular area can help me expand my business and boost its popularity in that area.

{character:Saturne} Of course, most importantly... Humans have an innate and unavoidable curiosity. Whenever one hears of such a common legend, known to all the locals, is it not only natural to wish to discover the truth behind the tale? To find out why it became a legend?
{character:player} To be honest, I'm a little... Well, surprised! I wouldn't have guessed that we're kindred spirits!
{character:Saturne} Oh? Do I not look like a seeker of knowledge?
{character:player} I'm not gonna lie, it wouldn't be the first thing that came to mind. Your appearance is more that of a serious and solemn business mogul.

{character:Saturne} Perhaps that's due to my many years locked in battles of wits and wile with other businessmen. If possible, I still wish to show you my more approachable side. After all, I feel as if we're already friends now, no?
{character:player} If that's the case, it looks like I need to pull out all the stops to help my friend satisfy his curiosity.
{character:Saturne} Well said! Here, a toast to our friendship!

{character:Saturne} This type of sweet yet acidic, fruity flavor, combined with the tantalizing dance of the bubbles, makes this beverage like a dream... Enticing people to imbibe, but loathe to finish.

{character:player} If you really like it that much, why don't you come to Éternité and have some freshly made? I always think that takeouts, no matter how carefully prepared and protected, always taste a little different.
{character:Saturne} What an exciting idea! I'll find some time to come by.
{character:player} She's called Miki Nikaidou, and she's a good friend who has helped me a lot. These days she runs a jewelry store called Tenhoukaku, in the west of the city.
{character:Saturne} Oho! A jewelry store too, you say? Who would have thought?
{character:player} You do gemstone business too, Saturne?
{character:Saturne} That's right. Northland, where I am from, is the world's largest gem producer, rich in all kinds of quality gemstones.
{character:player} Well, what a coincidence!

{character:Saturne} It sure is! I certainly never saw it coming, haha. I even know of this Tenhoukaku, seeing as it's the largest gem retailer in all of One Han City. I'd even like to work with them one day.
{character:Saturne} I'd heard that the manager of Tenhoukaku is a young up-and-comer, but... How one earth did she find out about the Four Greats?
{character:player} She'd mentioned in passing once that she'd taken part in the last Mahjong Soul Shrine tournament.
{character:Saturne} No wonder. The last tournament, you say? Is that the one that legend says was won by the four?

{character:player} Yes. She didn't say much about them, though, only that they were all very charming, each with their own, unique styles... Oh, speaking of this... Kazuha Saionji indeed is a rare beauty.
{character:Saturne} From what you've said, I suspect that Kazuha Saionji is one of the Four Greats.

{character:player} Yes. She lives in the Nishiha Dojo, and is an excellent swordswoman. As for the other three... I haven't met them, but I'd think they're also at the top of their respective professions.
{character:Saturne} Speaking of professions, I had heard that one of the Four Greats is also a business person, albeit in a different industry, and is quite a celebrity.
{character:player} After what you said, I became interested in the Four Greats too!
{character:Saturne} Aha! What did I say about humanity's insatiable curiosity, eh?
{character:Saturne} Actually, it's not just the Four Greats I'm curious about. I also want to know more about the Mahjong Soul Shrine's tournament.
{character:player} The tournament?
{character:Saturne} Don't you think it's a little odd? That a simple Mahjong tournament has the power to elevate one's status?
{character:player} Maybe it's to do with the legend that you get a wish for winning?

{character:Saturne} Even so, surely even the legendary tournament can only have one winner? So where did the four come from? Did they all tie for first? Or were they unable to crown a champion for some reason?
{character:player} Looks like I really need to talk to Miki. But curiosity killed the cat...
{character:Saturne} Well, my door will be forever open to you, my friend.
Ask how her search for her friend is going
Ask about the dark circles under her eyes
{character:player} Did anything happen while out on delivery yesterday?
{character:A-37} No.
{character:player} So why don't you want to deliver this order?

{character:A-37} Is it that obvious? Ahem... It really is too easy to let your guard down in a café. Anyway, it's no big deal. The person who placed that order has a... questionable sense of humor, which make me uncomfortable.
{character:player} Well, if you put it like that... We meet all sorts of people every single day at work. It's inevitable that there will be a few difficult ones. Maybe...
{character:A-37} It's fine. I'll go deliver it now. You take care of the café and we're all good.
{character:???} Hello.
10 minutes later
{character:player} You still haven't found your friend?
{character:Eve Krist} But it's okay. I know I'll find her eventually.
{character:player} I was under the impression you knew her address... But I'm starting to think you don't?
{character:player} Does your colleague also not know where she lives?
{character:Eve Krist} He probably does, but it's not so simple to ask him, because... Aha, well, the truth is I may have kind of snuck away to look for Lily.
{character:player} Lily? That's her name?
{character:Eve Krist} That's right. Lily D'Harques, my best friend. The only reason I'm in One Han City is to find her, and when I do she's going to get an earful before I take her back home!
{character:Eve Krist} By the way, I have an old photo I took with Lily ages ago. She's really stunning... Oh, here it is.

{character:Eve Krist} This was taken before I was away for work. I guess it's the last photo we took together. At the time, I had a few... health issues, and Lily was always worried about me. But how could she not realize that if she'd just sneaked off without saying anything then I'd be equally worried about her?
{character:player} Could there be something going on that she couldn't tell you?

{character:Eve Krist} Wait, you think that too? I told everyone that Lily wouldn't just up and disappear for no reason, but no one believed me. They all kept gossiping about her, saying she'd betrayed the church and the country. I don't believe this slander, as I know more than anyone just how much she loves Northland!
{character:Eve Krist} Please, forgive me. I shouldn't be boring you by prattling on like this.
{character:player} It's fine. I understand how you're feeling. If I get the chance, I'll be sure to keep my eyes out for anyone who looks like Lily.
{character:Eve Krist} Really?! I can't thank you enough, {var:player_nickname}. Sage Astra was right to guide me to this café. You must be the Chosen One of whom she spoke of.
{character:player} Well, I don't know about that! But this Sage Astra sounds like someone that can see the future?
{character:Eve Krist} Sage Astra is one of three sages of the Church of S. Decretum, who can see the past to know the future.
{character:player} If that's so, then why wouldn't she have just told you where to find Lily?

{character:Eve Krist} Oh, she tried! But she said there was some mysterious force preventing outsiders from observing the city. That's why I had to sneak into One Han City, to find Lily by myself... But, I didn't realize quite how big the city is...

{character:player} Could I have a copy of this photo? I said I'll help you, and I intend on doing so. Maybe I could ask around the customers, after all they come from all walks of life. Maybe someone has seen her.
{character:player} Did you not get enough sleep last night?
{character:Eve Krist} No. I don't know why, but I just couldn't sleep, kept tossing and turning...
{character:player} Probably just the effect of the coffee.
{character:Eve Krist} Eh?!
{character:Eve Krist} Such a little cup can pack such a large punch?
{character:player} Well, everyone's different. The boss knows more about this, maybe we could go ask her.
{character:player} What's all this, Boss?
{character:Reina Nanami} Oh! This? I'm getting everyone's new uniforms ready. Wait until the rush is over, then I'm going to need everyone to try them on, and make sure they fit.
{character:Reina Nanami} Eh?! This is... Aren't you Eve, from yesterday?
{character:Eve Krist} I must have been a terrible nuisance yesterday. I didn't expect you to remember me! I really am sorry.
{character:Reina Nanami} Not at all, not at all! Of course I remember you, it's not often that we get such beautiful, adorable customers. How could I forget?
{character:player} Actually, we wanted to find you because Eve is particularly interested in coffee.
{character:Reina Nanami} Coffee? That's my specialty! Ask away, Eve, and I'll do my best to answer.

{character:Reina Nanami} Hmm... I see. Well, I wouldn't worry too much, Eve. Most people in One Han City drink coffee as a little pick-me-up, as the caffeine stimulates the central nervous system—something particularly noticeable in those who don't regularly drink it...
{character:player} Did you find your friend?
{character:player} If you don't mind, I'd be happy to keep an eye out for you. Could you tell me a little about what they look like?
{character:Eve Krist} Really? That's great! Hold on, I think I have an old picture of me and Lily... Ah, here it is.
{character:Eve Krist} Even though I do love this photo, I can send it to you. After that, do with it what you need to!
{character:player} I'll do my best, even though I don't really know that many people.
{character:player} Wh-what's going on?
{character:Ichihime} I heard everyone talking, nyaa! Master was so brave. Even the most capable A-37 dare not make this delivery, yet Master went alone and came back safe and sound, nyaa!
{character:player} It's not what you think, Ichihime...
{character:Ichihime} Master is too humble! Ichihime knows what's up, nyaa!
15 minutes later
Reina Nanami
Ichihime

Eve spends a long time in the staff lounge before coming out with Reina, talking happily. They seem to have already become good friends, even if what happened to the person Eve was looking for was still a mystery.

{character:Eve Krist} Hmm... It was a few years ago now. I was away for a good while, and I returned to find she'd just run away. I've been looking for her for a long time, but it was only recently that a... colleague of mine informed me that she was in One Han City.
The picture looks over a decade old, as it shows Eve with long hair. Sitting next to her was a blonde nun, youthful and almost radiating a soft, pure aura.
Eve Krist
I recount what happened yesterday, then tell Reina about Eve's insomnia last night.
Obviously people change over time, and more than ten years have passed, but this glowing, golden-haired woman would be hard to forget.
